reference_site.name: Jezero crater delta
reference_site.citation: Mars 2020 Perseverance landing site (Jezero crater western delta)

target.citation: Mars has no liquid precipitation; target = driest end of the Earth population (p* = 0)

criteria.justification: Liquid precipitation on Mars is zero, which no Earth site reproduces in absolute terms; the analogue is the driest Earth land, so the criterion is a percentile of the eligible population (D-021).

target.citation: Near-surface relative humidity at Jezero; hand-entered from the Mars Climate Database (access date and version to record in T036)

criteria.justification: Very dry near-surface air controls weathering and dust behaviour along a rover traverse; Mars values are far below Earth's range, so the driest Earth percentile is the target.

target.citation: Mars surface has no vegetation; NDVI of bare ground (data-model placeholder 0.10)

criteria.justification: A Mars analogue for rover operations and remote sensing must be essentially plant-free; p90 over the footprint catches vegetated patches inside the circle.

target.citation: Jezero delta surface is bare rock and regolith (fraction ~1); data-model placeholder min 0.7

criteria.justification: Exposed rock and regolith are needed both for geological analogy and for spectral detection of minerals.

target.citation: Diurnal surface temperature range at Jezero (~tens of K above any Earth site); hand-entered, version to record in T036

criteria.justification: Large day-night swings stress hardware and drive thermal weathering; the Mars amplitude exceeds Earth's range, so the largest Earth percentile is the target.

target.citation: p90 slope at 926 m over the 20 km footprint around Jezero delta; to derive with T072 (planetary/dem.py)

criteria.justification: Regional slope at ~1 km baseline screens out mountainous terrain before refinement; baseline equals the slope_p90_1km layer output (D-020).

target.citation: p90 slope at 30 m from a Jezero CTX/HiRISE DTM over the footprint; to derive with T072

criteria.justification: Traversability at rover scale is the top operational constraint for a rover expedition; slopes must be computed at the same 30 m baseline on both bodies.

target.citation: RMS roughness at 30 m from a Jezero CTX/HiRISE DTM over the footprint; to derive with T072

criteria.justification: Surface roughness at the 30 m baseline describes obstacle density and terrain texture relevant for rover navigation testing.

criteria.statistic: class area fractions over valid pixels
criteria.valid_bands: CRISM summary parameters D2300, MIN2295_2480, OLINDEX3 vs EMIT L2B 0.4-2.5 um; BD1900_2/BD1400 (Earth water vapour) and parameters beyond 2.5 um excluded (mineral_classes.json excluded_parameters)

target.citation: CRISM MTRDR summary parameters over the 20 km footprint, extracted with planetary/crism.py (T073)

criteria.justification: Fe/Mg-smectite, carbonate and olivine co-occurring in the delta are the geological signature of Jezero's past lake; EMIT can detect the clay and carbonate classes on Earth.
criteria.note: Preliminary T073 extraction (FRT000047A3, FRT00005850; CRISM thresholds still marked verify): olivine 0.26, Fe/Mg-smectite 0.006, carbonate 0.0005 of valid pixels. EMIT cannot detect olivine, so this class can only be matched by mafic EMIT classes if added later.

target.citation: Hydrated / aqueous minerals (phyllosilicate, carbonate) detected in the Jezero delta by CRISM

criteria.justification: Aqueous minerals are both a resource indicator and the scientific reason for visiting the site.

target.citation: Mean surface pressure ~0.6 kPa (data-model placeholder; Jezero-specific value to record in T036)

criteria.justification: Earth surface pressure (~100 kPa) cannot reproduce Mars' thin atmosphere; kept for the analogy-limits statement.

target.citation: Mars surface gravity 3.71 m/s2 (data-model value; citation to add in T036)

criteria.justification: Gravity cannot be reproduced on Earth; it affects wheel-soil interaction and is stated as an analogy limit.

target.citation: THEMIS-derived thermal inertia of the Jezero delta (placeholder range from sample-edited.json)

criteria.justification: No global Earth thermal-inertia layer exists in the grid; kept to describe surface material and as an analogy limit.

removed_criteria.reason: Low relevance for a rover expedition; Mars wind values are model-only (FR-005).
No automatic global Earth landform classification (delta, paleolake) available (FR-005).
No global Earth dataset of pits or lava tubes (FR-005).

notes: v1 draft from data-model 'Mars v1 profile criteria'; all numbers are placeholders until T036 sources them and a second team member reviews targets, tolerances and vetoes.
